text:
<start_of_turn>user
एहि email कें मैथिलीमे बुझाउ:
Dear User, Your account password was changed on 12th March. If you did not make this change, please contact support immediately.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Password बदलि गेल अछि। जँ अहाँ नहि बदललहुँ तँ support सँ तुरंत संपर्क करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
We have updated our privacy policy. By continuing to use our app, you agree to the new terms.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Privacy policy बदलि गेल अछि। App उपयोग जारी रखलासँ अहाँ नव नियम मानैत छी।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
1 लाइनमे बताउ — What should I do if my UPI payment fails?
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Balance जाँचू, internet ठीक करू, फेर try करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
एहि error कें मैथिलीमे explain करू — 500 Internal Server Error
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Server मे किछु गड़बड़ी भेल अछि। थोड़े काल बाद फेर कोशिश करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Your KYC verification is pending. Please upload your Aadhaar card and PAN card within 7 days to avoid account suspension.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
७ दिनक भीतर Aadhaar आ PAN upload करू नहि तँ account बंद भए सकैत अछि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
छोट उत्तर दियौ — How to reset my password?
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Forgot Password पर क्लिक करू → OTP लिखू → नया password बनाउ।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
एहि notification कें मैथिलीमे बुझाउ:
Reminder: Your EMI of ₹2500 is due tomorrow.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
काल्हि ₹२५०० क EMI देबाक अछि। भुगतान करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
We noticed a suspicious login attempt on your account from an unknown device.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
अनजान device सँ login करबाक कोशिश भेल। Password तुरंत बदलू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
सिर्फ की करबाक चाही बताउ — How do I enable dark mode?
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Settings → Display → Dark Mode चालू करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Please verify your email address to complete registration.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Registration पूरा करबाक लेल email verify करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
एहि message कें मैथिलीमे बुझाउ — What is two-factor authentication?
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Two-factor authentication मतलब password + OTP दुनू दए login करब। एहिसँ account सुरक्षित रहैत अछि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Your delivery has been delayed due to bad weather conditions.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
खराब मौसमक कारण delivery मे देरी भेल अछि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
1 लाइनमे बताउ — Why is my app running slow?
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Storage कम अछि वा बहुत app एक साथ खुजल अछि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Congratulations! You have successfully completed your profile. You can now access all features of our platform.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Profile पूरा भेल। आब सब features उपयोग कए सकैत छी।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
एहि error कें मैथिलीमे explain करू — Your free storage of 15GB is almost full
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
१५GB free storage प्रायः भरि गेल। पुरान file हटाउ वा premium upgrade करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Alert: Your account password was reset. If this wasn't you, please call our helpline immediately.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Password बदलि गेल। जँ अहाँ नहि केलहुँ तँ helpline पर तुरंत फोन करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
छोट उत्तर दियौ — What is phishing?
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Phishing एकटा धोखा थिक जाहिमे ठग असली app जेकाँ दिखाकए OTP वा password माँगैत अछि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
We are performing scheduled maintenance tonight from 12 AM to 3 AM. Services may be unavailable.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
आइ राति १२ सँ ३ बजे धरि maintenance चलत। सेवा बंद रहत।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
सिर्फ की करबाक चाही बताउ — How to clear app cache?
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Settings → Apps → ऐप चुनू → Storage → Clear Cache।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Your loan application has been approved. Amount will be credited within 2 working days.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Loan स्वीकृत भेल। २ कार्यदिवसमे पैसा खातामे आएत।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
एहि message कें मैथिलीमे बुझाउ — Download limit reached. Please wait 24 hours.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Download limit खतम भए गेल। २४ घंटा बाद फेर download कए सकब।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Thank you for your purchase. Your invoice has been sent to your registered email.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
खरीदारीक लेल धन्यवाद। Invoice email पर पठा देल गेल।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
1 लाइनमे बताउ — What does airplane mode do?
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Sब network बंद भए जाइत अछि — call, internet, bluetooth सब।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Hello! We noticed you haven't logged in for a while. Come back and explore new features.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
बहुत दिनसँ login नहि केलहुँ। आउ आ नव features देखू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
छोट उत्तर दियौ — Why should I not share my OTP?
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
OTP शेयर केलासँ account हैक भए सकैत अछि आ पैसा चोराइ सकैत अछि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Your password will expire in 7 days. Please update it now.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
७ दिनमे password पुरान भए जाएत। आबे बदलू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
सिर्फ की करबाक चाही बताउ — How to turn off notifications?
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Settings → Notifications → ऐप चुनू → बंद करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Your profile is 70% complete. Add a profile photo to unlock more features.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Profile ७०% पूरा अछि। Photo जोड़ू आ आर features पाउ।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
एहि error कें मैथिलीमे explain करू — 401 Unauthorized
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Login नहि केलहुँ वा session खतम भए गेल। फेरसँ login करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
A new version of the app is available with bug fixes and performance improvements.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Nया version आएल अछि। Bug ठीक भेल आ app तेज भेल। Update करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
1 लाइनमे बताउ — How to contact customer support?
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
App मे Help → Support खोलू आ chat वा call करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Your cashback of ₹50 has been credited to your wallet.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
₹५० cashback wallet मे आबि गेल।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
छोट उत्तर दियौ — What is auto-renewal?
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Subscription खतम होइते अपने पैसा कटि नवीकरण भए जाइत अछि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
We have detected unusual activity on your account. Please verify your identity.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Account मे असामान्य गतिविधि देखल गेल। पहचान verify करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
सिर्फ की करबाक चाही बताउ — How to delete my account?
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Settings → Account → Delete Account। ध्यान राखू — data वापस नहि आएत।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Please rate your experience. Your feedback helps us serve you better.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
App कें rating दिअ। एहिसँ हम आर नीक बना सकब।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
एहि message कें मैथिलीमे बुझाउ — What is a QR code?
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
QR code एकटा चौकोन चित्र थिक। Scan केलापर website खुजैत अछि वा payment होइत अछि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Your account has been verified successfully. You can now enjoy full access.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Account verify भए गेल। आब सब सेवा उपयोग कए सकैत छी।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
1 लाइनमे बताउ — What is the difference between Wi-Fi and mobile data?
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
WiFi router सँ चलैत अछि, mobile data SIM सँ। दुनू internet दैत अछि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Your feedback has been submitted. Thank you for helping us improve.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Feedback दर्ज भए गेल। धन्यवाद।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
छोट उत्तर दियौ — How to share my location?
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
WhatsApp वा Maps खोलू → Location Share चुनू → जकरा पठेबाक अछि से चुनू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
सिर्फ की करबाक चाही बताउ — How to update an app?
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Play Store खोलू → app खोजू → Update दबाउ।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
एहि message कें मैथिलीमे बुझाउ — Your account will be deleted if unused for 30 days.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
३० दिन धरि login नहि केलासँ account हटा देल जाएत। आबे login करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
छोट उत्तर दियौ — What is cloud backup?
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Cloud backup मतलब data internet पर सुरक्षित राखब। Phone खराब भेलापर data वापस भेटत।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Convert to simple Maithili — Tap below to confirm with biometric authentication.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
निचलाका button दबाकए fingerprint वा face सँ पहचान confirm करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
I got this on WhatsApp. की करू? — You have won ₹10,000! Click here to claim.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
ई fraud message अछि। Link पर click नहि करू, delete करू आ sender कें block करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
1 लाइनमे बताउ — What is a digital wallet?
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Digital wallet app मे राखल पैसा थिक जे online payment मे उपयोग होइत अछि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
एहि error कें मैथिलीमे explain करू — Your session will expire in 5 minutes.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Session ५ मिनटमे खतम होएत। काज बचाउ नहि तँ फेरसँ login करए पड़त।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
सिर्फ की करबाक चाही बताउ — Bluetooth not connecting
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Bluetooth बंद कए फेर चालू करू आ device फेरसँ pair करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
छोट उत्तर दियौ — What should I do if I get a suspicious call asking for OTP?
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Call काटि दिअ। OTP कखनो नहि दिअ — बैंक कहियो नहि माँगैत अछि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
एहि notification कें मैथिलीमे बुझाउ — Storage almost full. 500MB remaining.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Storage मे केवल ५०० MB बचल अछि। पुरान files हटाउ वा cloud मे backup करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
1 लाइनमे बताउ — What is an app permission?
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
App permission मतलब ऐपकेँ camera, location वा contacts उपयोग करबाक अनुमति देब।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
सिर्फ की करबाक चाही बताउ — Face ID not working
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
फेरसँ try करू। नहि भेल तँ password सँ login करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
मैथिलीमे explain करू — What happens if I share my password?
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Password share केलासँ कोइयो दोसर अहाँक account use कए सकैत अछि आ data चोरा सकैत अछि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
छोट उत्तर दियौ — Refund कतेक दिनमे आबैत अछि?
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
सामान्यतः ३ सँ ७ कार्यदिवसमे।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
एहि message कें मैथिलीमे बुझाउ — Your invoice is ready. Tap to download.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Invoice तैयार अछि। Download करबाक लेल tap करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
1 लाइनमे बताउ — Why do apps ask for location permission?
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Nजदीकी सेवा, map वा delivery tracking जेकाँ features काज करबाक लेल।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
सिर्फ की करबाक चाही बताउ — App asking for too many permissions
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Keवल जरूरी permission दिअ। संदिग्ध लागलापर app delete करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
छोट उत्तर दियौ — What is two-factor authentication?
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Password + OTP दुनू दए login करबाक सुरक्षा तरीका।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Mobile data बहुत जल्दी खतम भए जाइत अछि। की करू?
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Background मे data use करएवाला apps बंद करू। Settings मे Data Usage जाँचू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
1 लाइनमे बताउ — What is a server error?
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
App जे website वा service पर depend करैत अछि ओतए समस्या आएल — अहाँक गलती नहि।
<end_of_turn>
